title: Loss of central connectivity
statement: Loss of Edge-to-Backend connectivity removes central visibility or management capability and may complicate recovery even if local control remains available.
attack_reference: MITRE ATT&CK for ICS: Loss of View is a useful adversarial analogue, but this project tests a failure condition rather than asserting an attack.

title: Unexplained local control transition
statement: A connectivity, configuration or security event causes the local energy-control state or set-point to change in a way that cannot be explained from authorised logic and collected evidence.
attack_reference: MITRE ATT&CK for ICS: Manipulation of Control / Impair Process Control.

title: Telemetry loss or misleading operational view
statement: Operational telemetry is missing, delayed, stale or inaccurate, causing the operator or controller to rely on an incomplete representation of site state.
attack_reference: MITRE ATT&CK for ICS: Loss of View and Manipulation of View.

title: Unauthorised remote or privileged control
statement: A remote or privileged identity performs an energy-management action without appropriate authorisation or reliable attribution.
attack_reference: MITRE ATT&CK for ICS: remote-service and unauthorised control paths are relevant threat-model references.

title: Insufficient event and time evidence
statement: Logs, timestamps or event records are insufficient to reconstruct a material control or connectivity event.

title: Unmanaged software dependency
statement: A material open-source or third-party dependency is deployed without known provenance, version ownership, upstream monitoring or an update decision process.

title: Physical or environmental loss of Edge function
statement: Physical access, loss of power or an environmental event disrupts or alters the site-local Edge function.

title: Unsafe or uncontrolled configuration change
statement: A configuration or controller change alters control behaviour without sufficient review, traceability or rollback capability.
attack_reference: MITRE ATT&CK for ICS: Modify Parameter is a relevant adversarial reference.

title: Recovery without state reconciliation
statement: Connectivity or service is restored but telemetry gaps, control state or operational history cannot be reconciled reliably.

title: Weak operational-data lineage
statement: Operational data cannot be traced reliably to its source, purpose, retention rule or authorised access path.

title: Loss of a measurement required by local control
statement: A meter or asset-facing measurement required by the local controller becomes unavailable or invalid while the controller continues to operate.

title: Unclear applicability or control ownership
statement: A regulatory requirement, risk treatment or assurance gap is accepted or reported without a clear applicability rationale and accountable owner.
